blocking_issues.location: pending.related_research_ids and section 'The UK's ...' not applicable; Spanish dossier opening and selection_rationale

blocking_issues.location: en.md and pt-BR.md chart 'Spain: institutional 2026 real GDP growth baselines' / 'Espanha: linhas de base institucionais para crescimento real em 2026'
blocking_issues.issue: The same-axis bar chart combines full-year 2026 forecasts (IMF and European Commission), an observed Q2 2026 year-on-year rate, and the observed 2025 full-year rate. blocking_issues.location: en.md and pt-BR.md chart 'Spain: 2025 electricity-system transformation' / 'Espanha: transformação do sistema elétrico em 2025'

evidence: Renewable share of generation 55.5%; including self-consumption 56.6%; CO2-free generation 75.5%; renewable installed capacity including self-consumption 68.9%.
